title: Staffing - Prod Planning Planner II
description:
Description:
100% onsite

Role Purpose
The Site Integrated Planner plays a critical role in aligning finish good production, material availability and distribution requirements with customer needs and inventory goals. This role combines three key responsibilities: Production Planning (PP), Material Replenishment Planning (MRP), and Distribution Requirement Planning (DRP). The planner ensures an operationally and financially optimized production, distribution and material requirements plan that delivers service and inventory goals while supporting efficient and reliable site operations.

Key Responsibilities
1. Production Planning
Develop and maintain a detail by SKU production plan, typically for a 13-weeks rolling horizon (short-term planning), for a designated area of products or production lines, balancing customer demand, inventory levels, material availability, and capacity.
Identify capacity constraints and adjust plans accordingly.
Integrate new product introductions into the production plan.
Establishes and maintain accurate production planning parameters (lot sizes, yields, safety stock) and partners with site teams to maintain accurate production Master Data (e.g. routings)
Use planning systems (e.g. ERP) and scenario analysis tools to build the optimal schedule.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (manufacturing, logistics, planning, finance) on scheduling assumptions and performance.

2. Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
Create and adjust material requirements schedules based on demand and inventory positions.
Create and manage purchase requisitions and purchase orders for materials, ensuring materials arrive on time and in full.
Proactively identifies material shortages or excess and work with suppliers and procurement to mitigate risks.
Establishes and maintain accurate material planning parameters (MOQ, lead times, safety stock) and partners with site/division teams to maintain accurate Master Data (e.g. BOM)
Align short- and mid-term supply plans with procurement
Partners with Procurement on material supply network improvement projects

2. Distribution Replenishment Planning (DRP)
Generate and maintain distribution replenishment plans across all downstream locations and channels based on demand forecasts, inventory levels, and transportation lead times
Balance inventory across the network to avoid stockouts or excess while minimizing logistics costs.
Release and track transfer orders from the site to receiving warehouses or distribution centers
Monitor in-transit and on-hand inventory at each location and take corrective actions as needed.
Coordinate with warehousing and transportation teams to ensure execution of planned shipments.
Utilize planning tools and ERP systems to create stock transfer orders (STOs) and monitor their execution
4. Analysis & Reporting
Analyze short-term (13-week) supply plans to identify gaps, bottlenecks, or risks.
Report and manages input key metrics including MPS, Material Availability rate*** backorder risks, inventory within limits, and capacity utilization.
Reports and manages gap analysis and plans for planning output metrics including site service results (e.g. Ship-to-Commit, OTIF) and inventory levels.
Monitor daily and weekly adherence to input KPIs, initiates/perform root cause analysis and support/owns corrective actions for recurrent execution and planning issues.

5. Systems & Process Improvement
Maintain and improve planning systems for both production and material planning.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase utilization, reduce waste, and optimize customer service.
Adopts and executes Corning’s integrated planning standards and support automation and digitalization efforts.

6. Collaboration & Communication
Partner closely with division’s integrated planning roles, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, customer service, and finance teams.
Clearly communicate changes in plans and rationale across the organization.
Support SIOP process by integrating near- and mid-term plans with strategic planning.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, engineering or related field —or equivalent experience.
2+ years’ experience in production, logistics, or material planning within a manufacturing or supply chain environment
Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and planning tools strongly preferred
Strong mathematical and analytical skill
Familiarity with planning system features like scenario analysis and capacity management
Analytical thinking and problem-solving
Effective communication—both written and verbal
Collaboration across cross-functional teams
Attention to details and ownership
Data interpretation and reporting
Continuous improvement mind-set

title: Medical Assistant
description:

The Medical Assistant plays a critical role in supporting clinicians and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care. This position is responsible for assisting with clinical and administrative functions that promote efficient care delivery, accurate documentation, and a positive patient experience. Clinical Excellence & Patient Care

  • Demonstrates a friendly, respectful, and patient-centered approach in all interactions.

  • Accurately documents patient information, vitals, and visit details.

  • Effectively manages patient flow, scheduling, and appointment confirmations.

  • Follows established protocols and workflows to support smooth clinic operations.

  • Maintains patient privacy and confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA and organizational standards.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
description:
100% Remote.
Our Opportunity:
We are seeking an entrepreneurial and passionate Technical Program Manager of Front-End Experiences to take our customer experience to the next level. We’re solving problems across a broad range of domains: marketing, trade, banking, retirement funding management, and employee stock reward and building ultra-fast and performant Front-End Digital Experiences that leverage a Headless Content Management System.
The role focuses on proactively engaging with our technical and business functions by providing personalized and customizable digital experiences to our prospects and clients to help them meet their financial goals. The program manager role will collaborate with other product and technology teams, as well as lead a cross-functional program team to holistically enhance a robust and efficient client experience across Digital Platforms. An ideal candidate will enjoy being part of a impactful and growing digital team, working in a fast paced environment, be process and data oriented, have strong communication skills, and have extensive experience with a secure, client-facing online technologies. This role requires a creative mind set, strong solutions-oriented view and ability to forge relationships with many internal and external partners.

What you’ll do:
  • Program leadership for web experience delivery
  • Drive end‐to‐end execution of initiatives that span the CMS, design system, and Next.js application layers.
  • Translate business and content requirements into structured technical initiatives with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Coordinate across engineering, design, content strategy, SEO, and marketing to ensure cohesive delivery.
  • Manage dependencies across CMS schema changes, API integrations, front‐end components, and deployment workflows.
  • Identify risks related to content migrations, breaking API changes, caching strategies, and release timing.

  • Participate in architectural discussions involving rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR), routing, caching, and performance optimization.

  • Collaborate with engineering leads to ensure front‐end and CMS changes align with long‐term platform direction.
  • Use analytics, Core Web Vitals, A/B testing data, and telemetry to guide prioritization and measure success.
  • Support teams in adopting best practices for accessibility, SEO, and performance.
  • Communication and stakeholder alignment
  • Produce clear written communication: program briefs, status updates, migration plans, and decision records.
  • Ability to translate business and product requirements into structured delivery plans, epics, and tickets in Jira.
  • Simplify complex technical issues—such as rendering tradeoffs or CMS schema impacts—for non‐technical stakeholders.
  • Align engineering, design, and content teams around timelines, expectations, and quality standards.
  • Facilitate decision‐making around content workflows, release processes, and cross‐team dependencies.
  • Operational excellence for web platforms
  • Coordinate postmortems for production issues, including rendering failures, broken content, or CMS outages, and drive long‐term fixes.
  • Improve processes around content publishing, preview environments, QA workflows, and deployment pipelines.
  • Champion performance, reliability, and accessibility as core pillars of the web experience.
  • Promote consistent use of design systems, component libraries, and CMS governance.

Required qualifications
  • Experience leading technical programs for web applications, digital experiences, or content‐driven platforms.
  • Strong understanding of modern front‐end architectures, especially frameworks like Next.js or React.
  • Familiarity with headless CMS platforms (e.g., Contentful, Sanity, Payload, Strapi, etc.) and content modeling concepts.
  • Ability to engage in discussions about rendering strategies, caching, API integration, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated success driving alignment across engineering, design, and content teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in simplifying technical complexity.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and create structure around evolving requirements.

  • Background in software engineering, front‐end development, or web platform architecture.
  • Experience with GROQ/GraphQL, REST APIs, CDN caching, and edge rendering.
  • Familiarity with design systems, component libraries, and accessibility standards.
  • Experience supporting SEO‐critical or high‐traffic web experiences.
  • Track record of improving content workflows, publishing processes, or CMS governance.

What you have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • 8-10 years of technical program management experience
  • Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project planning/execution skills including estimating and scheduling.
  • Must be self-starter, extremely detailed and analytical, and have a curious mind that enjoys digging into how things work and continuously strives to enhance the product, workflow and the process.
  • Comfort in a dynamic, fast-moving and collaborative work environment, with a positive attitude and solid work ethic.
  • Keen eye for recognizing consistent and efficient client experiences and promoting a continuous improvement culture. Experience on an agile digital product team is highly preferred.

title: Scientist, Analytical Sciences & Technology
description:
This is a temporary position that will be filled for 8 months, however, may be extended based on employee performance and planned workload.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Contractor Scientist within the Analytical Science and Technology team is responsible for supporting analytical method lifecycle activities including method development, qualification, validation, and technical transfer of methods for the testing of biologics drug substance and drug product samples. The candidate will execute non-GMP testing, non-GMP stability testing, reference standard qualification, and comparability studies to support clinical and/or commercial GMP manufacturing.

Duties/Responsibilities:
• Develop, author, and peer review standard operating procedures, analytical methods, protocols, reports, and other associated scientific technical documents.
• Perform testing of study samples to support upstream and downstream process development, characterization, and process improvements.
• Document and evaluate experimental results and perform data verification and trending.
• Provide technical expertise and guidance to support investigations and help troubleshoot analytical operational issues.
• Identify new analytical technologies and opportunities for technical advancements.
• Support the preparation and review of regulatory submissions related to analytical procedures, method development and validation, specifications, reference standards, extended characterization, and product stability/ shelf-life.
• Support regulatory inspections, third-party audits, and customer audits through participating in inspection readiness and addressing inspectional findings.
• Perform routine laboratory activities including sample management, instrument maintenance and calibration, inventory and ordering of supplies, general housekeeping, and other related activities.
• Work in a diverse group environment while focusing on inclusivity and safety to produce high quality, compliant results.

Quals--
Education/Experience/ Licenses/Certifications:
• B.S in Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or equivalent area of related study, with 2-5 yrs. industry experience in biologic/protein analytics or M.S./Ph.D. with 0-5 yrs. experience.
• Experience across the analytical method lifecycle in protein biotherapeutics for a variety of methodologies and instrumentation used in the testing and characterization of raw materials, excipients, in-process, drug substance, and drug product samples including HPLC/UPLC methods and various other analytical techniques (i.e., qPCR, ELISA, CE-SDS, iCIEF, SDS-PAGE, UV-VIS, western blotting, mass spectrometry, and cell-based assays) is preferred.
• Working knowledge and experience in the biopharmaceutical development process, GMP, PAT, CMC and regulatory guidance, ICH guidelines, and compendial requirements is desired.
• Experience authoring, validating, and coordinating timely transfer of test methods with and to Quality Control laboratories is desired.

QUALIFICATIONS
Specific Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, etc:
• Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Detail oriented with good organization skills.
• Ability to prioritize, independently manage and complete deliverables within given timelines.
• Ability to problem solve and apply risk-based critical thinking in a technical environment.
• Demonstrated history of continuous improvement is desired

Physical Demands:
• The role is a combination of laboratory and office-based work.
• The laboratory work requires appropriate levels of personal protective equipment (PPE). The role may require contact with
biohazardous materials such as live cell cultures and other hazardous chemicals including methotrexate, acids, and caustics.
Powdered materials and high temperature liquids and solids may also be handled. Use of a respirator may be required.
• Frequent repeated motions such as pipetting, lifting, bending, twisting, squatting, crouching, sitting, kneeling, climbing on stepstools, and reaching may be required. Repetitive use of arms/hands/wrists and grasping may be required.
• The role may require unassisted lifting (not to exceed 50 lbs.).

Work Environment:
• Position is primarily laboratory and office based with occasional work in a classified GMP manufacturing environment.
• Dynamic, fast-paced, interactive, and entrepreneurial environment.
• Position is a team and project-based position that may require occasional shift work, weekends, and holidays.

description:
Role: Regulatory Rates Analyst (9-month contract)
Location: Holmdel or Morristown, NJ – (4 days onsite, 1 remote)
Required: Rate experience within the utility industry
Preferred: Experience supporting rate cases

Position Overview

The Regulatory Rates Analyst (Contractor) supports the Rates and Regulatory Affairs organization in the preparation, analysis, and execution of regulatory filings, rate designs*** and compliance activities. This role provides critical analytical and project support for rate cases*** riders, tariff updates, and regulatory reporting to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with regulatory requirements and company objectives.

The Analyst works closely with internal stakeholders across Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Operations, Engineering, and Customer organizations to support regulatory initiatives and respond to information requests from the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities (BPU) and other parties. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast paced regulatory environment.

Key Responsibilities
• Support the development of rate cases*** cost recovery mechanisms, riders, and other regulatory filings through financial analysis, data validation, and documentation preparation.
• Perform studies, revenue requirement analyses, and rate impact calculations under the direction of the Manager Rates and Regulatory Affairs and senior staff.
• Assist in the preparation and maintenance of tariffs, schedules, and supporting workpapers in compliance with BPU orders and regulatory guidelines.
• Compile, analyze, and validate large datasets from Accounting, FP&A, Operations, Engineering, Customer, and operational systems to support regulatory filings and responses to data requests.
• Prepare draft testimony, exhibits, schedules, and narratives for regulatory proceedings and settlements.
• Coordinate responses to discovery requests and information inquiries from regulators, consumer advocates, and internal stakeholders.
• Monitor regulatory orders, filings, and policy developments and summarize impacts for the Manager and broader regulatory team.
• Support regulatory reporting, tracking of filing obligations, and implementation of approved rate changes***
• Assist with ad hoc analyses and special projects related to rates, revenues, or regulatory initiatives as needed.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field.
• 3–7 years of experience in utility rates, regulatory support, financial analysis, or a related analytical role (utility or regulated industry experience strongly preferred).
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data accurately.
• Proficiency in Excel and financial modeling; experience with regulatory models and large datasets.
• Ability to clearly document analyses and communicate technical information to both technical and non technical audiences.
• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet tight deadlines.
• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross functional teams.
• Familiarity with utility ratemaking principles, cost of service concepts, and regulatory processes preferred.

Contractor Expectations
• Works under the direction of the VP State Finance and Regulatory with day to day guidance from the Manager Rates and Regulatory Affairs and senior regulatory staff.
• Expected to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

description:

Feedback from JP9683, which was cancelled: Although the position is in the lab, it is essentially a data entry position. • Weigh filter samples in strict accordance with quality control procedures.

• Support daily lab operations as needed.

title: Sr. Analyst - III*
description:
Remote Role

We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.
Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

Job Description:
As Contractor, Real-World Evidence, you will provide strategic, scientific, and operational support for real-world evidence generation across the product lifecycle, with a core focus on the design and execution of external control arms (ECAs) and other complex observational studies. This role is central to Kite’s ability to contextualize single-arm trials and evolving treatment landscapes, support access, and strengthen evidence packages for innovative cell therapies.

This role, also, serves as the accountable scientific owner for high impact RWE studies intended to inform regulatory, HTA, payer, and clinical decision making. You may also serve as a leader of RWE in scientific forums, and collaborate with external physicians, scientists, and researchers, as well as alliance partners, on RWE activities.

Additional Responsibilities
• Provide strategic and scientific support for the design, execution, and communication of real world evidence across the product lifecycle.
• Responsible for ensuring RWE is fit for purpose for regulatory, HTA, payer, and clinical decision making.
• Provide end to end support for RWE studies, including, study design, protocol and SAP development, data source selection and feasibility, vendor oversight and quality control, analysis, interpretation, reporting, and financial stewardship.
• Provide RWE expertise and input for regulatory filings (e.g. MAA, BLA, sBLA) as well as response to questions from regulatory authorities and HTA agencies.
• Proactively identify opportunities where RWE can address key clinical or access uncertainties.
• Engage with external collaborators, registries, academic partners, and data vendors.
• Mentor and train team members on RWE methodology and analytics.
• Ensure scientific rigor, transparency, and reproducibility consistent with internal RWE standard.


Qualifications:
• Doctoral degree (e.g. PhD, MD, ScD, PharmD) in Epidemiology or related discipline, such as Outcomes Research, Medicine, Biostatistics from an accredited institution, with a minimum of 8+ years of relevant, post-graduation experience with doctoral training OR
• Master’s degree (e.g. MSc) in Epidemiology or related discipline, such as Outcomes Research, Medicine, Biostatistics from an accredited institution with 10+ years of relevant experience with Master’s training
• Deep understanding of observational study design and causal inference, real world data sources (claims, EHR, registries), bias, confounding, and sensitivity analyses.
• Strong technical reading, writing and communication skills
• Prior corporate experience in hematology/oncology therapeutic area is highly preferred
• Preferred: minimum of four (4) years of professional experience in the biopharmaceutical industry

Job Description:
The RWE Analyst will contribute to the Kite Real-World Evidence/Health Economic Outcomes Research (RWE/HEOR) Team as part of an effort to contribute to the strategies of the broader Kite Evidence Generation Team, which will include the conduct of timely, relevant, and rigorous analysis of real-world data (RWD) to address critical research questions and contribute to cross-functional initiatives.
The RWE Analyst will be responsible for developing, reviewing, and providing feedback on study documents, such as protocols and statistical analysis plans, and executing planned data analyses using administrative claims, electronic health record (EHR), and observational registry databases. Key Responsibilities:
• Support development of and provide critical appraisal of study protocols for research projects using RWD (e.g., medical claims, EHR, and observational registry databases)

• Conduct data reviews for primary/secondary data collected to ensure quality and reliability
• Communicate study results with a broader internal cross-functional audience

• Support cross-functional initiatives to develop and refine internal procedures, workflows, and best practices

• Master’s degree in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Statistics or related discipline from an accredited institution and 4+ years of experience working with a broad range of RWD, in academia, at a contract research organization, or in the biopharmaceutical industry

title: Power System Engineer Associate
description:

Job Description:


Provides engineering support to implement improved inverter-based resources (IBRs) capabilities and modeling for IBRs. Reviews submissions of technical data related to maximization of voltage ride-through (VRT) and frequency ride-through (FRT) to ensure compliance with *** requirements. Performs reliability power system studies, including steady-state and dynamic stability studies, to assess the impact of inverter based-resource VRT and FRT performance on the *** system. Works with market participants to understand requirements, facilitate submissions, and implementation of modifications or exemptions. Coordinates with internal *** teams to ensure all requirements related to VRT and FRT are being met. Serves as subject matter expert on topics related to VRT and FRT performance for inverter-based resources. Supports development of processes and procedures related to VRT and FRT maximization and may support development and implementation of future Revision Requests in this area.


JOB DUTIES



  • Performs reliability power system studies, including steady-state and dynamic stability studies, to assess the impact of inverter based-resource voltage ride-through (VRT) and frequency ride-through (FRT) performance on the *** system.

  • Reviews submissions of technical data related to maximization of voltage ride-through (VRT) and frequency ride-through (FRT) to ensure compliance with *** requirements.

  • Supports development of processes and procedures to implement NOGRR 245 and subsequent rulemakings at the PUCT and additional related *** revision requests.

  • Provides technical support for cross functional project team to develop processes to receive submissions, review IBR performance based on *** requirements, and coordinates with other departments.

  • Works with market participants to understand requirements, facilitate submissions, and implement modifications or exemptions.

  • Reviews, evaluates and recommends disposition of requests for extensions and exemptions from VRT and FRT requirements to management.

  • May represent *** is stakeholder groups.


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



  • Level 1 Engineer: No minimum work experience required in excess of degree requirements


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



  • Experience performing reliability power system studies.

  • Background in renewable generation resources – Wind, Solar, or Battery.

  • Experience analyzing voltage levels and relay or protection settings.

  • Experience with Python, Powerworld, PSSE, or PSCAD.

  • Good communication skills with ability to collaborate and communicate with external entities.


EDUCATION

title: Light Industrial - Journeyman Electrician
description:
Description/Comment: Responsibilities
Perform installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical systems, equipment, and components throughout the laboratory facility.
Evaluate electrical systems to ensure they meet the specific needs of sensitive and specialized medical equipment.
Run new circuits, test, and commission systems to support ongoing operations and equipment upgrades.
Read and interpret blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, and equipment specifications to determine proper design, installation, and configuration.
Ensure appropriate wire gauge, grounding, and protective devices are selected and installed in compliance with NEC and Virginia state electrical codes.
Conduct routine testing, inspections, and preventive maintenance of electrical infrastructure to ensure continuous operation in a 24/7 environment.
Respond promptly to electrical emergencies and service requests, minimizing downtime in this critical facility.
Document work performed, including materials used, test results, and compliance checks.
Collaborate with facilities, engineering, and laboratory staff to support projects and ensure minimal disruption to lab operations.
Able to respond to after hours emergency calls when necessary and provide guidance to on-site staff when needed.
Qualifications
Active Journeyman Electrician License in the state of Virginia (required).
Minimum of 4+ years of commercial/industrial electrical experience, preferably in critical environments (medical, hospital, lab, or data center).
Strong knowledge of NEC, Virginia electrical codes, and safety regulations.
Proven ability to read and interpret electrical blueprints, schematics, and technical specifications.
Experience running conduit, pulling wire, terminating panels, and installing distribution equipment.
Familiarity with emergency power systems, UPS, and generator-backed facilities (preferred).
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a high-pressure, fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Willingness to work flexible hours, participate in on-call rotations, and respond to urgent facility needs.
Required:

High School Diploma or GED – minimum requirement.
Completion of a State-Approved Electrical Apprenticeship Program (usually 4–5 years, ~8,000 hours of on-the-job training plus classroom instruction).
Journeyman Electrician License issued by the state (requires passing the licensing exam).
Continuing Education – most states require ongoing courses to maintain licensure, especially on electrical code updates (e.g., NEC revisions).
Active Journeyman Electrician License in the state of Virginia (required).
Preferred:

Minimum of 4+ years of commercial/industrial electrical experience, preferably in critical environments (medical, hospital, lab, or data center)
Associate degree or vocational/technical school certificate in electrical technology, construction, or related field.
Specialized training in life science or commercial facilities (since your role is in that environment).
Safety training certifications (e.g., OSHA 10/30, NFPA 70E for electrical safety).

title: Phlebotomist II
description:
Summary: The main function of a phlebotomist is to assist in performing various assigned duties, trouble shooting, training and making work flow recommendations.

description:

They work with clients, businesses, and organizations to offer expert guidance, build and manage key accounts, and achieve sales targets. Strong technical aptitude to understand and explain complex technical details to clients. Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and leadership skills. title: Phlebotomy - Phlebotomist I
description:
Description/Comment : The Patient Services Representative I (PSR I) represents the face of the company to patients who come in, both as part of their health routine or for insights into life-defining health decisions. The PSR I draws quality blood samples from patients and prepares those specimens for lab testing while following established practices and procedures. The PSR I has direct contact with patients and creates an atmosphere of trust and confidence while explaining procedures to patients and drawing blood specimens in a skillful, safe and accurate manner. The PSR I will demonstrate Leadership Behaviors while focusing on process excellence skills and sensitivity to confidentiality and accuracy to patient information.

Under the direction of the area supervisor, perform daily activities accurately and on time.
Maintain a safe and professional environment.
Performs with confidence, both the forensic and clinical specimen collection and processing duties following established practices and procedures.
Maintains required records and documentation.
Demonstrates organizational commitment and promotes a positive image to patients, clients, employees and the public in general.

Job Requirements:
Ability to provide quality, error free work in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal on-site supervision.
Excellent phlebotomy skills to include pediatric and geriatric.
*Flexible and available based on staffing needs, which includes weekends, holidays, on-call and overtime.*

Required Education:
High school diploma or equivalent REQUIRED
Medical training: medical assistant or paramedic training preferred.
Phlebotomy certification preferred (Required in California, Nevada, and Washington).

Work Experience:
Minimum of 6 months experience REQUIRED. One(+) years phlebotomy experience preferred.
Customer service in a retail or service environment preferred.
Keyboard/data entry experience a must.

EEO:

Once the start instructions are received, which is typically the Friday prior to the candidate's start date the associate will receive starting instructions from the account management team.

title: IT Architect
description:
Provide a short description of the Position: The incumbent will act as the Enterprise Architect for the DOT Transportation Safety Management and Operations (TSMO) Technology Program providing the strategic vision and overarching blueprint for how Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems and capabilities will align with and enable the organization's business strategy. They ensure that technology investments, across both domains, are integrated, efficient, and drive the DOT TMSO Technology Program's strategy, vision and goals

Provide a list of the day-to-day tasks to be performed by the Selected Candidate: Responsibilities include but not limited to the following: 1. Business Strategy Alignment: Understand the organization's strategic objectives, business processes, and desired outcomes. Translate Business Strategy into IT/OT Strategy by developing a IT/OT strategy that directly supports and enables the achievement of business goals. This includes identifying how technology can drive innovation, efficiency, and competitive advantage. 2.Enterprise-Wide Architecture Development: Create and manage a comprehensive enterprise architecture framework that encompasses business, data, application, and technology domains, with a specific focus on the integration of IT and OT. Establish guiding principles and standards for technology selection, development, and integration across the entire enterprise, ensuring consistency and interoperability between IT and OT. Define the desired future state of the organization's IT and OT landscape, outlining how systems and processes should evolve to meet strategic objectives.


Provide a list of the day-to-day tasks to be performed by the Selected Candidate: 3. IT/OT Convergence Strategy: Design the overarching architectural approach for integrating IT and OT systems, ensuring seamless data flow, secure communication, and interoperability. Identify opportunities where IT and OT can be leveraged together to create new business value, improve operational efficiency, or enhance decision-making. Analyze and propose solutions for the inherent differences and challenges in integrating IT and OT, such as differing lifecycles, security requirements, and communication protocols. 4. Technology Governance and Roadmapping: Provide strategic guidance on the selection of enterprise-wide technologies, platforms, and solutions, considering their impact on both IT and OT. Create technology roadmaps that outline the evolution of the IT and OT landscape over time, aligning with business strategy and anticipating future needs. Define and enforce enterprise-wide technology standards to promote interoperability, reduce complexity, and optimize IT/OT investments. 5. Solution Oversight and Guidance: Ensure that significant IT and OT solution designs align with the enterprise architecture principles and standards. Offer strategic architectural guidance to solution architects, project managers, and development teams to ensure their work contributes to the overall enterprise vision. Recognize and plan for the management of technical debt across both IT and OT environments. 6. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication: Clearly articulate the enterprise architecture vision, strategy, and roadmaps to senior leadership, business stakeholders, and IT/OT teams. Provide architectural insights to support strategic decision-making regarding technology investments and initiatives. Foster collaboration and build consensus among diverse stakeholders regarding architectural direction.

title: Phlebotomist I
description:
Summary: The main function of a phlebotomist is to assist in performing various assigned duties, trouble shooting, training and making work flow recommendations.

Position Responsibilities: Experience doing blood draws, labeling specimens, centrifuging specimens, recording maintenance data and decontamination, updating patient information, etc. Collects and stores specimens according to established procedures. Properly explains in a clear but courteous manner the process of the venipuncture (blood drawing) and or other specimen collection (ex. urine or fecal) as required. Demonstrate technique/s using straight needles and/or butterfly needles. Fully understand all of the physicians' orders. Matches laboratory requisition forms to specimen tubes. Label, centrifuge, split, and freeze specimens as required by test order. Check all test requisitions or computer label against script to ensure 100% correct. Package specimens for transport. Stores specimen sample according to required temperature, places samples in appropriate collection container/ tube, accurately labels, follows different procedures as outlined by specific to protocol deemed necessary for transport to maintain integrity of the specimen. Understand and comply with OSHA and DEP regulations. Attend annual department trainings. Answer telephone calls, read laboratory results to satisfy inquiries.

Minimum Qualifications: Valid Phlebotomy certification for the state where you will be employed as required in some states. Minimum of 6 months' work experience performing venipunctures in a fast paced lab or hospital setting. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. High School Diploma or GED 0-2 years of experience

title: Network Engineer - III
description:
Job Title: Network Engineer – III
Location: REMOTE (Overnight Shift)
Duration: 12+ Months

The successful candidate will be responsible for the advanced configuration and operating system upgrades of carrier-class Cisco and Nokia equipment that tie together a complex, multivendor nationwide data network. The Engineer will also be responsible for working on up-and-coming virtualization technologies in the Pacific and North Central Markets. They will assist with and perform implementation responsibilities for one or more COINs and work closely with the Implementation and Engineering teams to carry out our strategic technology goals and transition from VXLAN to the eNSE platform. This new network leverages virtualization and software defined networking to transform how we provide products and services while maintaining our position as the industry leader. Client is seeking a motivated and driven engineering professional who will assume responsibilities for engineering IP networking build projects and work closely with the Capacity Planning, Design and Operations teams to implement our strategic technology goals.
Work 3rd shift, 8-hours, 5-day work weeks (Monday-Friday mornings).
  • Plan, prioritize, and schedule maintenance window changes with many groups both inside and outside the office with minimum supervision during the daytime and then implement these changes during scheduled maintenance windows while adhering to corporate standards.
  • You will need hands-on experience configuring routers, switches and related network equipment.
  • Preferably: Cisco Carrier Routing Systems (CRS), Cisco Network Convergence System (Company), ASR 9K, ISR 3945, Nexus 3K, 7K, 9K, Juniper MX-480, MX-960.
  • Operating Systems: IOS, XR-IOS, NX-OS, JunOS. Implement configuration changes for the directional Intelligent Edge Networks.
  • These include but are not limited to: SAP eNSE fabric, Access eNSE fabric, EPC element migration to eNSE, ISP peering routers, VCP Edge connectivity, eNSE connectivity to MSE and UT.
  • Leveraging automation tools like Python, NSO, DCNM, VTS, Pronghorn and Nuage to complete the above projects.
  • Transport circuit turn up/troubleshooting.
  • Turn up new and disconnect older circuits of varying bandwidths using procedures written by both an internal engineering group and outside vendors. The work is done in parallel with other internal groups.
  • Work remotely with local operation team members throughout the United States to deploy and troubleshot newly installed racked routers and switches into client’s data center locations.
  • Work independently with minimum supervision and meet aggressive deployment dates and timelines.
  • Ability to quickly adapt and learn new tasks and processes around deploying new routers and switches in a remote setting.
  • Engineering the network configuration for the onboarding of client’s private cloud tenants.
  • Solid understanding of Networking specific technologies: IPV6, L2VPN, L3VPN, OSPFv3, MPBGP, QOS/Traffic Engineering, MPLS (LDP & TDP) and VRFs.
  • Perform BAU maintenance work such as ACL updates and software upgrades on border leafs, access leafs, and spines on the eNSE fabric.
  • Utilize network monitoring tools, during maintenance windows, to ensure that all monitored network equipment is functioning in accordance with company standards and policies, both before and after changes are made.
  • Be proficient with network configuration compare tools such as Ultracompare, Diff Checker, Notepad ++.
  • Take accountability to review MOPs and automated dry-run outputs with the engineering team before any scheduled change to ensure accuracy.
  • Required to attend daytime MOP review and team/project synch meetings.
  • Regularly assist team members in an “overwatch” role during cutovers, migrations, and upgrades through network monitoring tools to ensure customer service interruptions do not occur.
  • Engage in both intra and interdepartmental communication to plan, schedule, prioritize, and prepare for maintenance window activities.
  • Enter all night changes into the change management database “Kirke” and ensure all notifications are approved prior to maintenance window activities.
  • Work closely with local onsite Network Assurance team to validate no customer impacts were sustained to our customers.
  • All pre/post configuration/traffic checks will need to be performed on each device being worked on.

MUST HAVE SKILLS (Most Important):
  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including nights and an occasional weekend as necessary.
  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a desire to do your best each day.
  • Must possess extensive knowledge of Layer 1 troubleshooting for copper and fiber cabling including Cat5/6 copper cabling and fiber types SC, LC, FC, MPO, MOP creation and implementation.
  • Must have in depth knowledge and expert comprehension of Command Line Interface (CLI) commands for Nokia 7750/7706/7250, Cisco 55A1,5504, 5508, 9508, CRS-16, Nexus 3k/5k/7K/9K (IOS, XE, XR, NX-OS).
  • Experience with IP Layer 1-3 for Edge Networks and strong knowledge of MPLS.
  • Hands on experience with virtualization of networks and implementing updates and changes on working devices.
  • Ability to follow and implement detailed engineering design documents.
  • The ability to articulate and explain your work and self through email and phone.
  • Knowledgeable in Layer 1 remote connectivity to network devices via console and Ethernet, copper (CAT5/6) and SC, LC, MPO fiber cabling.
  • Ability to work closely with others, manage the workload you are assigned, and schedule work/project manage tasks with other installation teams and groups.
  • Ability to clearly communicate ideas in order to lead phone calls to implement changes and thoroughly test for any residual issues afterwards during maintenance window hours.
  • Need to be comfortable working on the phone and troubleshooting with local support personnel to correct OBM (Out of Band Management) and Ethernet/fiber cabling issues.
  • Functional knowledge of TCP/IP (IPv4 and IPv6).
  • They must have the ability to follow and implement detailed engineering design documents and join team/project calls throughout the day in various US time zones and have the ability to convey status and work updates.
  • Administrative skills to track and update emails, tickets, projects, and work logs.
  • Knowledge of spine and leaf fabric networking.
  • Working knowledge of VXLAN and BGP.
  • Ability to pay CLOSE attention to details and be a thorough will all aspects of your work.

DESIRED SKILLS:
  • CCNA or CCNP certifications
  • Hands on experience with Nokia SR-OS devices
  • Experience with virtualization technology in a corporate environment
  • Knowledge of Cloud Computing (Client, Openstack, AWS, Azure, or similar).
  • Some experience with data center and cloud technologies such as Linux OS, Client, Open-Stack, Ansible, Chef/Puppet and/or Docker.
  • Five or more years of experience that involved working on large, complex data networks.
  • Experience working with data networking gear and troubleshooting data networking problems involving: TCP/IP, BGP, MP-BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPv4, IPv6, L2VPN, L3VPN, SIP, and other advanced LAN/WAN technologies and concepts.
  • Experience with planning for multiple technical projects AND implementing them by working with people using multiple lines of communications (phone, e-mail, face to face, etc.) in order to deliver them on time.
  • Good understanding of 3G and 4G call flow.

LOGISTICS: 40 hour work week (5 days/8 hours) overnight shift no overtime.


EEO:
“Mindlance is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of – Minority/Gender/Disability/Religion/LGBTQI/Age/Veterans.”

title: Network Administrator   -  Expert
description:
Provide a short description of the Position: Act as Expert Network Administrator for the DOT Transportation Safety Management and Operations (TSMO) Technology Program to ensure the reliable, secure, and efficient operation of the network infrastructure that connects both Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems on a day-to-day basis.

Provide a list of the day-to-day tasks to be performed by the Selected Candidate: Duties include but not limited to the following: 1.Architect technology solutions/systems that meet or exceed Agency business requirements aligning with NYS ITS Technical and Security Service standards and strategies. 2.Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Network gear deployed in support of DOT Traffic Signals and Traffic Management Centers (TMCs) including performance tuning, log analysis and security. 3.Work with COTS Vendors and Agency business areas for gear installation, configuration, and testing. This includes pre-configuring field devices for installation by Agency business users. 4.Review the network architecture and gear currently in place and provide detailed specifications for proposed solutions and recommendation of appropriate solutions, upgrades, replacements working with ITS and Agency business teams to recommend solutions to improve it. 5.Provide L3 Technical support for an enterprise-level DOT Traffic Safety Management Organization and Intelligent Transportation System. 6.Use Agency business applications to update inventory details on field network equipment 7.Train field technicians on aspects of remote connectivity at a level necessary to assist field technicians effectively and remotely in installation and maintenance field systems 8.Adherence to ITS security and technology policies 9.Some off-hours work will be required 10.Remotely guide field technicians (business users) through installation and maintenance of field equipment

title: Contingent Workforce & Procurement Specialist
description:
Contingent Workforce & Procurement Specialist

Location

Remote / Hybrid (as applicable)

Position Summary

We are seeking a Contingent Workforce & Procurement Specialist to support the day-to-day operations of the contingent labor program and procurement activities. This role will manage contractor onboarding/offboarding, supplier coordination, compliance tracking, reporting, and stakeholder support across multiple business units.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with contingent workforce programs, staffing vendors, procurement operations, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced corporate environment.

Key Responsibilities

Contingent Workforce Operations

  • Manage the full lifecycle of contingent workers, including requisitions, onboarding, extensions, and offboarding

  • Partner with hiring managers to support staffing needs and contractor engagement processes

  • Coordinate with HR, IT, Legal, Procurement, and Information Security teams to ensure compliance and approvals are completed

  • Conduct initial screening conversations with candidates before manager review

  • Maintain accurate contractor and supplier records

Vendor & Procurement Support

  • Support contingent labor supplier management and vendor coordination

  • Track contracts, supplier performance, and workforce-related documentation

  • Assist with sourcing activities, supplier evaluations, and procurement initiatives

  • Ensure adherence to procurement policies and vendor engagement processes

Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure onboarding requirements, background checks, and documentation are completed prior to contractor start dates

description:

description:

Title – Product Manager - Marketing Technologies


Role Overview


We are seeking a high-energy, strategic Product Manager (Contractor) to lead the digital commerce strategy and roadmap for the PureWick Retail MarTech team. While our Product Owner focuses on sprint execution and day-to-day delivery, this role will serve as the commercial and strategic anchor—working closely with business leadership and marketing stakeholders to maximize ROI, optimize the conversion funnel, and align business vision with technical execution. You will own the "why" and the "what," ensuring our MarTech ecosystem directly supports critical revenue initiatives, patient experience goals, and long-term platform growth.



Key Responsibilities


1. Strategic Roadmap & Prioritization



  • Translate high-level business goals and marketing initiatives into a cohesive, prioritized product roadmap that drives measurable revenue growth.

  • Evaluate and scope complex commercial initiatives to define the Minimum Viable Product (MVP).

  • Own the macro-prioritization of the product backlog, balancing immediate quick-turn marketing requests with long-term foundational upgrades.


2. Business Alignment & Stakeholder Leadership



  • Serve as the primary strategic partner to Marketing, Finance, and Operations leads, ensuring technical initiatives directly address business pain points and consumer needs.

  • Lead strategic alignment sessions, including pre-mortems and problem-solving processes (PSP), to mitigate operational risks before major feature rollouts.

  • Communicate the product vision, delivery timelines, and release impacts transparently to both executive leadership and downstream operational teams.


3. MarTech Ecosystem & Vendor Management



  • Oversee the strategic value of our Salesforce multi-cloud ecosystem (Commerce Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Health Cloud) and critical third-party integrations (e.g., payment gateways, fraud prevention, and behavioral analytics).

  • Manage relationships and alignment with external strategy consultants, technical partners, and offshore development vendors to ensure execution matches business expectations and established SLAs.

  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to transfer strategic requirements smoothly into the development pipeline, ensuring technical designs respect business intent.


4. Funnel Optimization & Growth Analytics



  • Analyze end-to-end user behavior and purchase funnels using tools like FullStory and Google Analytics 4 to identify conversion drop-offs and friction points.

  • Define and champion data-driven conversion rate optimization (CRO) strategies, including complex A/B testing for promotional offers, landing page creative, and checkout flow enhancements.

  • Establish and monitor product KPIs (Average Order Value, conversion rates, and acquisition efficiency) to justify future platform investments and address immediate revenue gaps.


Qualifications


Minimum Requirements



  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in product management, digital commerce, or business strategy, with a proven track record of owning product roadmaps and driving growth in an e-commerce environment.

  • Strategic Prioritization: Strong proficiency in macro-prioritization frameworks, roadmap development, and balancing commercial business goals with technical constraints.

  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and presentation skills; proven ability to influence executive leadership, align cross-functional business units, and manage external vendor/consultant relationships.

  • Analytical Problem Solving: Highly data-driven with a proactive approach to risk mitigation (e.g., pre-mortems) and utilizing formal problem-solving processes to address complex business hurdles.


Preferred Skills



  • Deep familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem, specifically Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), Marketing Cloud, or Health Cloud.

  • Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), A/B testing methodologies, and web analytics tools like Google Analytics 4 and FullStory.

  • Experience navigating technical integrations for payment processing, automated fraud prevention (e.g., Stripe, Signifyd), or compliance-driven digital frameworks.

  • Prior experience working within the medical device, healthcare, or highly regulated industry.


Certifications


Certified Product Manager (CPM), Pragmatic Institute certification, or equivalent advanced product management training preferred.

title: APP DEV&TST - Scrum Master
description:
APP DEV&TST - Scrum Master
Top Skills:
1. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP) is a plus.
2. High Energy is required and Commercial experience is preferred.
3. Experience as a Scrum Master, with a proven track record of successfully delivering software development projects. Pharma GxP software development experience preferred
4. Agile Expertise: Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and best practices.
5. Leadership and Communication: Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively manage teams and engage stakeholders.
6. Analytical and Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify issues, assess risks, and develop solutions.
7. Facilitation Skills: Ability to facilitate meetings, discussions, and decision-making processes effectively.

Position Summary:
Seeking an experienced Scrum Master to partner with program leadership on a high-priority transformation initiative focused on redefining CRM workflows and driving full ownership of solution delivery. This role will lead cross-functional teams in defining clear data and UI requirements to enable intuitive, insight-driven pre-call and post-call experiences with minimal friction for field users. The ideal candidate will guide agile execution from requirement refinement through wireframing, ensuring solutions support structured planning, seamless execution, effective follow-up, and reduced administrative burden. Experience leveraging modern data and AI-driven frameworks is preferred to deliver scalable, user-centric outcomes in a dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities and Duties:
1. Facilitate Agile Processes:
• Scrum Ceremonies: Organize and facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
• Sprint Planning: Assist the team in defining sprint goals, planning tasks, and estimating effort for each sprint.
• Backlog Management: Work with the Product Owner to ensure the product backlog is well-groomed, prioritized, and ready for upcoming sprints.
2. Team Support and Coaching:
• Agile Coaching: Coach team members on Agile principles and practices, helping them to understand and adopt Scrum methodologies.
• Remove Impediments: Identify and remove any impediments or obstacles that may hinder the team's progress.
• Foster Collaboration: Promote a collaborative team environment where open communication, trust, and respect are encouraged.
3. Project Coordination:
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, machine learning engineers, software developers, and other stakeholders, to ensure alignment and integration of projects.
• Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status, risks, and issues.
4. Continuous Improvement:
• Retrospectives: Facilitate sprint retrospectives to identify areas for improvement and implement actionable plans to enhance team performance.
• Process Optimization: Continuously assess and improve Agile processes and practices to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
5. Performance Tracking and Reporting:
• Metrics and KPIs: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure team performance and project progress.
• Progress Reporting: Prepare and present regular progress reports to stakeholders and senior management.
6. Risk Management:
• Risk Identification: Identify potential risks and issues that may impact project delivery and develop mitigation strategies.
• Issue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve any issues that arise during the project lifecycle.

title: Quality Control Laboratory Specialist
description:
Location: Rockville, MD
Length: 6 month contract

Position Summary:
Seeking an energetic and experienced individual with cell therapy quality control background to join our Quality Control Analytical (QCA) team. The successful candidate will contribute to the advancement of our product pipeline by performing in-process testing, lot release testing, sample management, equipment maintenance, and other assigned tasks. This position is essential for ensuring that the laboratory meets the high standards required for cGMP QCA.
This position includes occasional weekend support primarily operates on the following shift, which is subject to change:
· Monday to Friday, 5x8, 8AM - 5PM ET 2080 hours

Essential Responsibilities:
· Perform cGMP release testing (e.g. cell counting, flow cytometry, ELISA, cell-based cytotoxicity, dPCR) for cell therapy products and in-process samples.
· Perform in-process flow cytometry testing to support manufacturing operations.
· Support the vialing and cryopreservation of in-process characterization samples.
· Receive, verify, label, store, and track samples, controls, and reagents to ensure traceability and timely transfer to testing laboratories, using paper and electronic systems and operating temperature-controlled units.
· Support laboratory cleaning and equipment maintenance activities
· Support cell line thawing, passaging and maintenance.
· Author and/or review analytical test results and technical documents, including analytical method qualification protocols and reports, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
· Document activities, record observations, and complete all paperwork in accordance with cGMPs, SOPs, and protocols.
· Execute protocol-driven method qualification, verification, and validation, and support analytical technology transfer and method lifecycle management activities.
· Escalate and document invalid, OOS/OOT results; support deviations, CAPAs, and change controls; and contribute to investigations as needed.
· Follow Safety, Health, and Environmental procedures, maintain a safe and organized laboratory environment, and use appropriate PPE and aseptic/biocontainment practices.
· Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
· Bachelor's degree preferably in Biology or equivalent with 1-2 years of relevant cGMP laboratory experience; or Associate's degree preferably in Biology or equivalent with 2-3 years of relevant cGMP laboratory experience
· The ideal candidate will possess excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to analyze raw data effectively.
· Experience with sample receipt, storage and transfer.
· 1-2 years executing routine and non-routine analysis for cGMP lot release and stability testing using techniques including, but not limited to, cell culture, flow cytometry and cell-based methods, PCR (dPCR, qPCR), immunoassays (ELISA), etc.
· Familiar with basic computer applications such as Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel.
· Experience operating and maintaining Temperature-Controlled Storage Units.
· Demonstrated ability to collaborate, work, and communicate effectively across organizational interfaces in a fast-paced dynamic team setting.

Preferred Qualifications:
· Experience in Cell or Gene Therapy.
· Well versed in various analytical techniques such as flow cytometry, qPCR, dPCR, cell-based potency and/or ELISA experience.

title: Global Quality Specialist|ALX|US
description:
Job title: Design Quality Lead DHT (Digital Health Technology)
Location: New Haven, CT, Hybrid (3 days onsite / 2 days remote)
Contract duration: 12 months
Interview - 2-round virtual interview

This is what you will do:
The primary purpose of this position is to build internal QMS oversight for AI DHT or AI SaMD development with business partnering AI DHT / AI SaMD companies. The business partner (BP) shall develop the technologies and shall execute processes in line with their own QMS. The BP shall also complete the regulatory submissions for the product unless Alexion decides to perform this role. The DHT Q shall ensure key quality criteria are in place in the Alexion QMS so that development work can start and oversee the BP design control activity to ensure key quality milestones are achieved for EU and US markets.
The DHT Q is the quality liaison between Diagnostics Strategy & Development group (Product Development), Medical Device Quality and Regulatory Affairs to ensure internal and partner compliance with Quality Standards, Regulations and Design control activities for the clinical and commercial development of AI DHT / AI SaMD products. The role enables efficient communication for decision making related to quality and product development.
This is a hybrid position, requiring 3 days office attendance at either the Alexion New Haven or Boston office.
You will be responsible for:
• Responsible for creating QMS related SOPs and/or guidance documents for the collaboration with BP to meet requirements of ISO 13485:2016, IVDR, IEC 62304, FDA Part 820 QMSR. Clearly identify roles and responsibilities for Alexion and BPs for device technical documentation generation including DHF and Device Clinical Performance.
• Support R&D Quality in the supplier qualification process (Operational Due Diligence) during the onboarding of BP for clinical development.
• Responsible for ensuring that BP development process and regulatory strategy for such devices and systems comply with all WW regulatory requirements. Quality responsibilities for BP for which the DHT Q shall have oversight shall be documented in a BP quality oversight plan.
• Identification of any known or new gaps to SOPs. Support product development create Quality Plans or document mitigations to ensure gaps and risks are addressed appropriately ensuring project deliverables are compliantly kept on track.
• Liase with AstraZeneca partners to leverage existing resources, processes and procedures. Where appropriate involve AstraZeneca partners to support program deliverables.
• Device BPs shall supply Alexion with milestone development summary reports per the quality oversight plan. The DHT Q shall be responsible for Quality oversight, participation in the review and approval of key deliverables including Design Development, Regulatory submissions, Design Transfer activities including CAPA, Risk Management, Change control, Design Reviews.
• Responsible for providing input and review of Design Control deliverables e.g. per ISO 13485:2016 Section 7.3 Design and Development and IEC 62304.
• Assist in quality review of Regulatory submissions and response to queries.
• Supports regulatory inspections and compliance.
• Supports cross functional activity to ensure audit readiness is in place for all aspects of the product lifecycle.
• Other duties as assigned.
You will need to have:
• B.Sc. / B Eng degree in Engineering or Science or equivalent experience in regulated industry.
• Preferable 7 years +’ cGMP experience within quality in a medical device, SaMD R&D, ideally clinical phases through commercial
• Understanding of Medical device development for the full lifecycle starting at the Design Control phases.
• Knowledge of the regulatory and compliance requirements of design control for AI DHT / AI SaMD medical devices (FDA QSR 21 CFR Part 820 / ISO 13485 and Regulation (EU) 2017/745).
• Demonstrated ability in decision making, problem solving and project management.
• Collaborate, negotiate, influence and lead in a matrix organization
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Proven record in demonstrating agility
We would prefer for you to have:
• Experience in successful development, filing and gaining approval for global regulatory submissions
• Experience in development of AI DHT / AI SaMD and regulatory approval 510(K), De Novo or PMA.

title: Senior Legal Tech & AI Integration Engineer
description:
Senior Legal Tech & AI Integration Engineer

Job Brief
We are looking for a Senior Integration Engineer to architect the next generation of our Legal Operations ecosystem. This role is at the intersection of Enterprise SaaS and Agentic AI. You will be responsible for moving beyond static data syncing to creating a dynamic, real-time context layer for our Legal AI tools using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Your primary focus will be to harvest contextualized data records coming from our systems and applications and integrate into a common platform for legal analysis and insights.
This position reports to our Director, Finance & Legal Systems, and is a critical hire as we modernize our professional services billing lifecycle.

Responsibilities:
Key Initiatives & Projects
  • MCP Server Development: Architect and deploy MCP Servers for our core SaaS applications (Salesforce, Ironclad, Gong) to enable AI models to securely query real-time deal data without massive ETL overhead.
  • The "Pocket Guide" Automation: Build the infrastructure to pull deal summaries, meeting intent (Gong), and firmographics (ZoomInfo) into a unified context window for Harvey.
  • Harvey & Ironclad Agentic Sync: Enable Harvey to not only analyze executed contracts but to "look up" live workflow statuses in Ironclad through standardized MCP connections.

Key Responsibilities

  • Standardizing AI Context: Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers to solve the "N×M" integration problem, ensuring our AI tools have a single "USB-C" style connector to our data.
  • Complex Data Orchestration: Map complex schemas from Salesforce (Opportunities/Quotes) and Ironclad (Metadata/Attributes) into structured JSON-RPC formats used by MCP.
  • Pipeline Reliability: Ensure high-availability for the data streams feeding the Legal AI stack, managing API rate limits and authentication (OAuth/JWT) across all platforms.
  • Technical Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with Legal Ops to define "Context Blueprints"—ensuring the AI receives the right data from Gong transcripts or Salesforce fields to minimize hallucinations.
Requirements:

Required Technical Profile

  • Deep Integration Expertise: Advanced knowledge of REST APIs, Webhooks, and Event-Driven Architecture.
  • AI Protocol Fluency: Hands-on experience (or deep technical understanding) of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its implementation (TypeScript/Python SDKs).
  • SaaS Ecosystem Knowledge: * Salesforce: Ability to write SOQL/SOSL and navigate complex custom objects.
    • Ironclad: Experience with the Ironclad API and Workflow Designer data structures.
    • Gong/ZoomInfo: Experience extracting intent signals and firmographic data via API.
  • Modern Dev Stack: Proficiency in TypeScript or Node.js (standard for MCP servers) and experience with Jira for sprint-based delivery.

Technical Stack

  • AI/Protocol: Google Gemini for LLM, Agent Space, Claude (Cowork and Code), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Harvey AI.
  • SaaS:
    • Enterprise tools: Slack, GSuite, Atlassian Suite, Snowflake, Databrics
    • Sales tools:, Salesforce (CPQ/Sales Cloud), Ironclad CLM, Gong, ZoomInfo, Zip, Workday
    • Legal tools: Harvey, SimpleLegal, Logikcull, Airtable,
  • Infrastructure: Node.js/TypeScript, Docker (for MCP server deployment), GitHub.

Job Description:
This role provides technical engineering and operational support for the Automated Password Reset (Client) application, which is built on the Bravura Password Manager platform.
This position is not a software development role. The position focuses on platform stability, configuration, integration support, operational stability, risk reduction, and day-to-day operational health of Client, while software development responsibilities remain with dedicated software engineers.
The role is critical to maintaining system reliability, supporting audit and regulatory commitments, and reducing operational risk caused by single-resource dependencies within the Client platform.

Primary Responsibilities:
  • Provide technical operational support for the Client platform and Bravura Password Manager
  • Support configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Client integrations with enterprise credential systems (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle, mainframe platforms, non‐AD systems)
  • Assist in incident response and root cause analysis for Client‐related production issues
  • Support platform upgrades, vendor patches, and post‐upgrade stabilization activities
  • Perform environment validation and health checks across DEV, QA, and PROD
  • Support access, entitlement, and password-management workflows across integrated systems
  • Collaborate with software engineers, IAM architects, and service owners to ensure smooth handoffs between development and operations
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies as a platform SME (stand‐ups, backlog refinement, retrospectives)
  • Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and operational readiness artifacts
  • Helping support from an engineering perspective the Bravura Password Manager, the product behind changing the employee password.
  • We are one of that vendor’s largest client and few people have experience supporting it outside the organization. Have been using it for 20 years.
  • Doesn’t need to be a software developer, though that does show a level of technical ability. Anything in Information Security or Credential Management is probably a good fit with experience.
  • Also use CyberArk Password Management Vault. Sailpoint is another popular tech on the market but is very general so people may not have exactly done the relevant tasks.
  • Most complex part of the system is User Off-Chains, the rules applied to people who log in and how they need to credential themselves based on their allowances.
  • Usually have team standups around 11:30 ET. Will be understanding the architectural needs of the system. Right now they are going through a database migration and figuring out capacity needed. Also upgrading the product and strategizing the effect on the integrations with the 13 other systems it plugs in with like databases, active directory, and mainframes.
  • Finance experience will help people integrate, will understand the amount of regulations to deal with and how that slows the process. Healthcare and dealing with HIPAA may be a good field to explore as an alternative.
  • Soft skills has been an issue in the past, needs to be able to take initiative and dive into troubleshooting.
  • Typical 5 day business schedule, 3 day hybrid with no assigned days. Not first line of support, but may be pulled into emergency issues with things they’ve worked on. May be involved in changes to production that could come up after hours ad hoc. Would still be on a 40 hour schedule.

Job Description: Senior Data Modeler (Enterprise CDM Owner – Cross Asset)

Job Title
Senior Data Modeler / Domain Model Lead – Enterprise Common Domain Model (CDM), Capital Markets

Role Type
Internal enterprise product owner for the CDM (canonical model stewardship + governance + adoption enablement)

Job Summary
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Data Modeler to serve as the internal enterprise owner for a cross asset Common Domain Model (CDM) supporting capital markets and investment banking. This role is responsible for defining and governing canonical business semantics for products, trades, lifecycle events, parties, agreements, reference data, and related domains—enabling interoperability across front office, risk, finance, operations, regulatory reporting, and analytics platforms.
The successful candidate will combine deep capital markets domain knowledge with strong modeling discipline and a control-minded approach to governance, schema versioning, lineage, and adoption. Experience aligning enterprise models to ISDA CDM and leveraging the FINOS ecosystem (standards practices, model sharing patterns, and open collaboration approaches) is highly valued.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
1) Enterprise CDM Ownership & Strategy
• Own the enterprise CDM vision, scope, and roadmap for capital markets domains (cross-asset; end-to-end lifecycle).
• Maintain a clear domain decomposition (bounded contexts) and ensure consistent semantics across lines of business and platforms.
• Establish model “north star” principles: canonical semantics first, implementation-agnostic logical model, interoperability, and auditability.
2) Canonical Modeling (Cross Asset, Trade Lifecycle, Post Trade)
• Design and maintain conceptual/logical/canonical models for:
o Products (rates, credit, FX, equities, securitized products as applicable)
o Trades & positions, events/lifecycle states, allocations, payments/cashflows
o Parties & legal entities, accounts, agreements/CSA, settlement instructions, reference data
• Normalize identifiers and hierarchies (trade IDs, UTI/USI considerations where applicable, party identifiers, instrument identifiers) to support interoperability and reconciliation.
• Provide model patterns for event-driven and state-based lifecycles to support downstream processing consistency.
3) CDM Governance, Controls, and Operating Model
• Establish operating model for CDM governance in a regulated environment (e.g., design authority participation, steward/owner workflows, approvals, audit-ready documentation).
o Enforced modeling standards (naming, definitions, relationships, cardinality, constraints)
o Lineage/metadata completeness (dictionary, glossary alignment, stewardship mapping)
• Manage schema/model versioning and controlled release processes for a shared enterprise model:
o semantic versioning
o backward compatibility/deprecation strategy
o release notes and consumer migration guidance
o impact analysis for breaking changes
• Maintain canonical-to-physical implementation patterns (e.g., lakehouse tables, event schemas, API contracts) without conflating the logical CDM with any single platform.
6) Adoption Enablement Across the Enterprise
• Drive adoption by producing and maintaining:
o Mapping templates and guidance for onboarding systems to the CDM
o Canonical transformation patterns (ingest ? standardize ? validate ? publish)
o Reference examples (sample payloads, canonical entities, event examples)
• Partner with engineering, architecture, and platform teams to ensure the CDM is implementable and consistently consumed.
• Facilitate design reviews to prevent proliferation of conflicting definitions and “shadow models.”
7) AI / LLM Integration (Enterprise Enablement)
• Ensure the CDM supports AI/ML and LLM use cases by:
o Designing AI-ready canonical datasets (analysis-grade views, curated canonical training sets)
o Enabling semantic layers for RAG/knowledge retrieval (controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, metadata enrichment)
o Supporting unstructured-to-structured modeling patterns (e.g., confirmations/agreements ? extracted terms ? canonical fields)
• Collaborate with AI governance / model risk partners to ensure CDM usage supports:
o Reproducibility (versioned training datasets tied to CDM releases)
o Explainability inputs (clear definitions and lineage)
o Audit-ready documentation of semantic decisions
________________________________________

Required Experience (Investment Banking / Capital Markets)
• 5+ years of hands-on data modeling experience within an investment bank, broker-dealer, or capital markets technology organization, supporting front-to-back workflows (Front Office / Risk / Operations / Finance / Regulatory).
• Demonstrated experience building, governing, or materially contributing to a canonical / enterprise Common Domain Model (CDM) (or equivalent canonical model) used across multiple systems, lines of business, or platforms in a capital markets environment.
• Proven ability to lead working sessions with stakeholders across Trading, Risk, Operations, Finance, Regulatory Reporting, Architecture, and Data Engineering to drive consensus on canonical semantics and resolve competing definitions.
• Experience defining canonical entities and relationships for core capital markets domains, such as:
o Trades, positions, lifecycle events, valuations, and cashflows/payments
o Parties/legal entities, accounts/books, agreements/CSAs, and reference data
• Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise adoption of a canonical model:
o creating mappings from source systems to canonical entities
o onboarding multiple producer/consumer systems
o resolving semantic conflicts and driving standardized definitions across stakeholders
• Direct experience performing data element mapping and harmonization across heterogeneous trading and post-trade platforms (vendor + proprietary), including lineage and reconciliation requirements typical of investment banks.
• Experience supporting risk and regulatory use cases that rely on consistent canonical semantics (e.g., exposure aggregation, sensitivities, trade reporting, risk controls, finance substantiation), including evidence of controls-minded modeling.
________________________________________
Preferred Qualifications (Strengthened for ISDA/FINOS SME)

• Experience performing alignment mapping from internal models to ISDA CDM and defining extensions
• Familiarity with FINOS ecosystem practices relevant to domain models (interoperability patterns, documentation approaches, reference implementations/tooling patterns)
• Experience integrating canonical models into:
o streaming/event schemas (e.g., lifecycle event payloads)
o lakehouse/warehouse physical models
o API and message contract governance
• Exposure to AI/LLM enablement patterns (RAG-ready metadata, semantic layers, curated training datasets) in regulated environments

Core Skills & Competencies
